name: Manual of Bodily Health

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Study it (48 hours)
powers.text: Spend 48 hours over 6 days studying it: your Constitution score and its maximum increase by 2. The book's magic is then gone for a century.

summary: Study it for 48 hours over 6 days: +2 Constitution, and your maximum rises by 2.
text: Magic infuses this book of health and diet advice. Devote 48 hours within a span of 6 days or less to reading it and following its regimen, and both your Constitution score and its maximum go up by 2. The manual's magic is then spent, returning after a century.
